config.scope: All graphs and requests from the unchanged recurrent protocol; ordinary unconstrained final-letter generation. Same questions, different prompt/readout procedure; not a causal architecture ablation.

definitions.accuracy: Exact final uppercase letter after stripping surrounding whitespace; invalid responses remain failures.
definitions.pointwise_interval: 95% Wilson interval over graphs at each requested depth; not a simultaneous band.
definitions.aggregate_interval: Saved 95% graph-cluster bootstrap interval, stratified by seed and graph type; all requests of a graph stay together.
definitions.smoothing: None. Lines connect measured integer depths; no interpolated measurements.
